crossRefs.note: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became…
If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self…

translations.web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.
translations.bsb: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
translations.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
translations.asv: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to minister unto them in carnal things.
